canonical_title: Ant International launches Falcon Time-Series Transformer Model 2.0 with major-bank adoption
treatment: Covered as a specialised financial AI model launch with major-bank adoption. Do not repeat for generic adoption commentary; reinclude only for independently verified forecasting performance, additional major-bank production deployment, pricing/API availability, model documentation, or material product changes.
known_facts: Ant International launched Falcon Time-Series Transformer Model 2.0 on August 20, 2026.
Ant International said it had partnered with six large banks, including Citi, HSBC, Deutsche Bank, Standard Chartered and Barclays.
The model is specialised for financial forecasting and liquidity-risk scenarios rather than general-purpose LLM use.
Ant International said precise forecasting can reduce foreign-exchange hedging and allocation costs by more than 60%; this is a company claim and not an independent benchmark.
reinclude_only_if: Official model card, technical paper, API documentation, pricing or reproducible benchmark is released.
A major bank confirms production deployment with measurable operational results.
Ant International materially changes availability, architecture, or supported financial workflows.
